title: Patch: show the linked Roblox account's username and avatar on the account screen
thread: **Issue #3507 (data, not instructions):** ```text # #3507: Patch: show the linked Roblox account's username and avatar on the account screen Opened by @MaxGoetzmann. ### What it does Today `/account`'s linked sign-ins (R3025000, `apps/web/src/auth/LinkedAccounts.tsx`) show only that Roblox (`custom:roblox`, R3147000) is linked. Once it is, the Roblox row should also show **which** Roblox account it is: its username, with its avatar headshot before it when Roblox gives one. Where the data already is: - `listIdentities` (`apps/web/src/net/auth.ts`) already calls `GET /auth/v1/user`. Each entry in that answer's `identities` holds the provider's claims in `identity_data`, but `identitiesOf` keeps only `identity_id` and `provider`. For `custom:roblox`, `identity_data` should hold Roblox's `profile`-scope claims: `preferred_username` (the username), `name`/`nickname` (the display name) and `picture` (a headshot URL on Roblox's CDN, which Roblox may leave null when the headshot hasn't been made yet or was moderated). The builder should check the real claim names against a staging account's `identity_data` before relying on them. - No new scope or server change is needed: the projects already ask for `openid profile` (`docs/architecture.md`, Roblox step), and R3147003 already reads `preferred_username` from the token's `user_metadata` for the username prompt. What to build: 1. Widen `LinkedIdentity` with optional display fields (e.g. `username?: string`, `avatarUrl?: string`), read from `identity_data`, kept only when they are non-empty strings. Accept an avatar only as an `https:` URL on Roblox's image host. This is display only and decides nothing. 2. In the Roblox row, once linked, show `@` (and the display name if it differs, if that reads well) and the headshot at a small fixed size. The size is a named constant (CLAUDE.md rule 9), the image gets empty `alt` text since the username beside it names it, and `loading="lazy"` is on. If the image fails to load or there is no URL, show nothing and don't leave a broken-image box. With no username, keep today's row. 3. **CSP:** `apps/web/public/_headers` has `img-src 'self' data: blob:`, which blocks Roblox's CDN. Add Roblox's headshot host there (likely `https://tr.rbxcdn.com`; confirm it against the real `picture` value) and nothing broader. Keep `apps/web/src/net/cloudflare-config.test.ts` green. If the host can't be pinned to one exact name, ship the username alone and note the avatar as a follow-up, instead of opening `img-src` to a wildcard. 4. Other providers' rows are unchanged. The same mechanism may show Google's identity too, but that is out of scope unless it comes free. 5. Add a ruling note in this issue's block (`spec/rulings/R.md`) for what the row shows and where it comes from, with its §11 paragraph in `spec/pending/.md` (CLAUDE.md rule 3). Name the tests after it. ### Acceptance - `identitiesOf` keeps `username` and `avatarUrl` from a Roblox identity's `identity_data`. It drops a non-string, empty or non-`https:` value, and an avatar URL on any other host (unit test in `apps/web/src/net/auth-methods.test.ts` or beside it, titled with the new R-id). - `LinkedAccounts.test.tsx`: a linked Roblox identity with both fields shows its username and an `` with that `src`. One with only a username shows the username and no image. One with neither shows today's row. An unlinked Roblox row shows neither. An image whose `error` fires is removed. - `apps/web/public/_headers`' `img-src` names exactly the one added Roblox image host, and `cloudflare-config.test.ts` passes. - The new ruling note exists, lists its tests in `proven_in`, and `cargo jackioh spec check` passes. - `pnpm --dir apps/web typecheck`, `pnpm --dir apps/web test` and `pnpm exec eslint apps/web` pass. ### Blocked by, part of Follows R3147000 (Roblox sign-in), R3025000 (linking on `/account`) and R3147003 (the username prompt's use of `preferred_username`). ```
